title: メットライフ生命社員　銀行など36出向先から2400件超内部情報持ち出し
extracted_text: メットライフ生命の社員が、銀行など36の出向先から2400件以上の内部情報を無断で持ち出していたことが分かりました。 「経済部」は、「日本や世界の経済」を、多角的にウォッチする部。「生活者の目線」を忘れずに、政府の経済政策や企業の活動、株価や為替の動きなどを継続的に定点観測し、時に深堀りすることで、日本社会の「今」を「経済の視点」から浮き彫りにしていく役割を担っている。世界的な課題となっている温室効果ガス削減をはじめ、ＡＩや自動運転などをめぐる最先端テクノロジーの取材も続け、技術革新のうねりをカバー。生産・販売・消費の現場で、タイムリーな話題を掘り下げて取材し、映像化に知恵を絞り、わかりやすく伝えていくのが経済部の目標。財務省や総務省、経産省などの省庁や日銀・東京証券取引所のほか、金融機関、自動車をはじめとした製造業、流通・情報通信・外食など幅広い経済分野を取材している。
translated_text: It has been revealed that an employee of MetLife Life Insurance illegally extracted over 2,400 pieces of internal information from 36 secondment destinations including banks without authorization. The "Economics Desk" monitors "Japan and the world's economy" from multiple perspectives. Without losing sight of the "consumer's perspective," the desk continuously observes and sometimes delves deeply into the government's economic policies, corporate activities, and stock and foreign exchange movements to highlight "what's happening now" in Japanese society from an "economic viewpoint." The desk also continues coverage of cutting-edge technologies including AI and autonomous driving, addressing the global challenge of greenhouse gas reduction, and capturing the wave of technological innovation. The goal of the Economics Desk is to dig into timely topics from the front lines of production, sales, and consumption, apply creative approaches to video coverage, and convey information in an easily understandable way. The desk covers government ministries such as the Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications, and Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry, as well as the Bank of Japan and Tokyo Stock Exchange, financial institutions, automotive and other manufacturing industries, and a wide range of economic sectors including distribution, information and communications, and food service.
title_en: MetLife Life Insurance Employee Extracted Over 2,400 Pieces of Internal Information from 36 Seconded Institutions Including Banks
